statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity
The service was ordered to assess for further embolic risk
The claim was denied under reason code CO-97
